content.comment_body: Tested three networked [product_name] devices; everything seems to work, but a red question mark appears on the virtual [product_name] operator device, and the displays of the [product_name] modules are flashing. What could be the reason? I have another setup on the same network that runs normally without this issue.

I haven't come across this type of error before. Additionally, your description doesn't cover all aspects. Which [product_name] displays are blinking — the physical devices or the virtual ones? Are all three affected? You could try uploading your [product_name] project for review. Edit: This section of the forum is international, so posts should be in English.
Thanks for your response. It was the real displays that were flashing. The issue has disappeared, but I'm not sure what caused it. Thank you.
Could you please upload your programs or the project for your network setup?

analysis.insight_summary: Users reported an incident where physical display panels on three interconnected [product_name] modules began flashing unexpectedly, while the system itself continued to operate normally. This specific issue had not been widely encountered before and appeared to resolve without intervention, leaving the actual cause undetermined. Troubleshooting was hindered by a lack of clear error feedback and uncertainty about what led to the display behavior.
analysis.user_expectations: Users desire reliable and predictable system performance, without unexplained errors such as flashing displays. They also expect straightforward diagnostics or clear explanations for any malfunctions that occur.
